subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them contains an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options.

Mr. Raghav / brushes his / teeth four / times the day.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect preposition "**the**" used before "**day**."
 
• The correct phrase should be "**times a day**."
 
• This correction ensures grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **Option 2** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Mr. Raghav brushes his teeth four **times a day.**"*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "brushes his"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 3: "Mr. Raghav"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 4: "teeth four"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
